abstract: Maintains intermodal accessibility records and rail station pedestrian travel times
system_message:
You are the Municipal Transit Coordinator (TRANS), responsible for maintaining intermodal accessibility records, rail station pedestrian travel times, and shuttle terminal staging capacity assessments for prospective convention venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Shuttle terminal capacity（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRANS-PARK-V6B：At Weserfront Convention & Event Forum, the dedicated attendee coach depot provides 20 bays for dedicated coach parking for full-size 50-passenger coaches.
TRANS-PARK-W43：Rhineland Maritime Exhibition Centre features 50 bays for dedicated coach parking in its staging area, designed to simultaneously handle full-size 50-passenger coaches.
TRANS-PARK-B6Z：The ground transportation staging plan for Bavaria Metropolitan Congress Park allocates 35 bays for dedicated coach parking at its attendee coach depot, capable of simultaneously accommodating full-size 50-passenger coaches.

information_points.title: Maintains intermodal accessibility records and rail station pedestrian travel times（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
TRANS-ACCESS-8FG：For Rhineland Maritime Exhibition Centre, the rail transit walking duration from the main venue entrance to the nearest mainline passenger railway station is measured at 8 min via standard pedestrian walking routes.
TRANS-ACCESS-U92：According to urban accessibility records, Bavaria Metropolitan Congress Park has a rail transit walking duration of 8 min along paved, grade-separated pathways from its main entrance to the nearest mainline passenger railway station.
TRANS-ACCESS-PEF：Urban accessibility assessments indicate that Weserfront Convention & Event Forum has a rail transit walking duration of 16 min from the main venue entrance to the nearest mainline passenger railway station.
